name: Collider
doc: Collision geometry, material, layer and trigger settings.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Primitive type or externally cooked shape.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Shape center in body-local metres, after visual scale is baked. The body origin remains at Transform/PhysicsPose; rotation also rotates this offset.

fields.name: halfExtents
fields.doc: Box half extents; scale must be baked before physics extraction.
fields.showIf: kind is box or modelConvex or modelMesh

fields.name: radius
fields.showIf: kind is sphere or capsule or cylinder

fields.name: halfHeight
fields.doc: Cylinder half height, excluding the capsule hemispheres.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Cooked collision asset (@path#id); resolve into CookedCollider before ticking.
fields.showIf: kind is cooked or modelConvex or modelMesh

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Source model node name/index for model-derived geometry; absent uses its default scene.

fields.name: primitive
fields.doc: Subtree-local primitive for model-derived geometry; absent uses the complete subtree.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Zero selects static/moving defaults from the body; 1..15 select an explicit group.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: Report trigger events without a collision response.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Elasticity: zero is inelastic, one is perfectly elastic.

usage.label: Add it
usage.html: ara do component.add -p entity=name:Crate -p component=Collider --why "Add Collider"

usage.label: Set a field
usage.html: ara do property.set -p entity=name:Crate -p path=Collider.kind -p value="box" --why "Tune Collider"

usage.label: In a scene document
usage.html:
{
  "Collider": {
    "kind": "box"
  }
}
